clips.title: The story
paras: Sentinel Tower crowns the apex of Sentinel Hill, standing as the primary vantage point and headquarters for defenders in Westfall. From its heights, Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia organize their desperate defense against bandits, gnolls, and the growing shadow of the Defias Brotherhood.

Erected upon the crest of Sentinel Hill, Sentinel Tower is the military heart of unsettled Westfall. With Stormwind's official army largely absent and withholding aid, local volunteers and veterans banded together to create a central redoubt. The stone tower grants lookouts an unbroken view across the dusty plains, from the abandoned pumpkin patches to the misty shores, giving early warning when rogue highwaymen or gnoll raiding parties begin to prowl.
